create.name: Gordon Smith
create.bio:
Gordon Smith is a Scottish medium and teacher of mediumship whose career runs to more than forty years. He grew up in Glasgow, had experiences of spirit as a child, and in his twenties began sitting in the development circle of his teacher, Mrs Primrose, whose methods he now hands on. He became known through demonstrations of evidence from the spirit world and through television work, and over several years his accuracy was put to the test by Professor Archie Roy of Glasgow University.

His teaching treats mediumship as a discipline of sensitivity, patience and kindness rather than spectacle. Workshops cover how to build a link with spirit, sitting regularly in a circle, spiritual healing and trance, with the wider aim of greater self-awareness. He has written more than twenty books, among them the memoir Spirit Messenger, the beginners' guide Mediumship Made Easy and the course book Intuitive Studies, and they have been translated into many languages. Since the 2020 lockdowns he has taught chiefly over Zoom, often with German translation, alongside live weekend events, and on YouTube he answers short questions from the public about the afterlife in a series he calls the Soul Library.

books.title: Spirit Messenger
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: Gordon's own account of how he grew from a Glasgow child with unexplained experiences into a working medium. It follows his training in a development circle and the people he met along the way.

books.title: Mediumship Made Easy
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: A starting guide for readers who want to explore their own sensitivity to spirit. Short chapters and exercises cover awareness, intuition and the first steps of making a link.

books.title: Intuitive Studies: A Complete Course in Mediumship
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: Gordon's training laid out as a structured course, built on the way he teaches in workshops. It moves from basic attunement through to giving messages, with practices for each stage.

books.title: Through My Eyes: A Medium Reveals the Reassuring Truth about the Afterlife
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: Drawing on decades of sittings and demonstrations, Gordon describes what he has come to understand about life after death. The tone is quiet and reassuring rather than sensational.

books.title: The Unbelievable Truth: Powerful Insights into the Unseen World of Spirits, Ghosts, Poltergeists, and Altered States
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: Gordon answers common questions about ghosts, hauntings and other unseen activity from a medium's point of view. He also looks at altered states and how mediums work within them.

books.title: Life Changing Messages: Remarkable Stories from the Other Side
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: A collection of accounts from Gordon's sittings, each showing how a message from someone who had died changed things for the person receiving it.

books.title: Positive Vibes: Inspiring Thoughts for Change and Transformation
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: A small book of short reflections meant to be opened at random. Each offers a thought for steadying the mind and living with more kindness.

free_resources.title: The Soul Library
free_resources.description: A free YouTube playlist in which Gordon replies to questions sent in by the public, each in a few minutes. Topics range from the afterlife and spirit guides to how mediums work.
